# Fixture skins

Each folder holds a copy of one skin's `shortcuts/` folder and a `userdata.json`, the input for the golden builds in `test_golden_skins.py`. The files in a folder keep the license of the skin they were copied from, not the add-on's GPL-2.0.

| Folder | Skin | Authors | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `skin.aeon.next` | Aeon Next | MikeSiLVO | https://github.com/MikeSiLVO/skin.aeon.next | CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 |
| `skin.aeon.nox.silvo` | Aeon Nox: SiLVO | MikeSiLVO | https://github.com/MikeSiLVO/skin.aeon.nox.silvo | CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 |
| `skin.arctic.zephyr.martian` | Arctic: Zephyr (martian) | jurialmunkey, beatmasterrs, martian89 | https://github.com/martian89/skin.arctic.zephyr.martian | CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 |
| `skin.arctic.zephyr.rounded` | Arctic: Zephyr - Rounded | jurialmunkey, beatmasterrs, nanomani | https://github.com/Nanomani/skin.arctic.zephyr.rounded | Creative Commons Non Commercial 3.0 |
| `skin.ftv` | fTV | Hitcher | https://github.com/Hitcher/skin.ftv, copied from the fork at https://github.com/MikeSiLVO/skin.ftv | CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 |
| `skin.kodebug.broken` | Kodebug Broken Test | MikeSiLVO | not published | CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 |

`skin.arctic.zephyr.martian/icons.txt` lists the file names in that skin's `extras/icons/` folder, which its icon override tests check against.
